description:
Send CDP commands through Verity Sidecar's authenticated WebUI-tab relay. This uses the browser extension's chrome.debugger permission and the same signed-in WebUI auth channel; it does not require --remote-debugging-port or /api/ws.

Use method='cdp.listRelays' to see connected sidecars and method='cdp.listTabs' to list browser tabs.

CDP reference: https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/
name: browser_cdp_sidecar

method.description: CDP method name (e.g. Runtime.evaluate, Page.navigate). Special: cdp.listRelays, cdp.listTabs, cdp.detach.

relay_id.description: Optional relay id if multiple sidecars are connected.
